# Agentic Software Engineering (SE 3.0) — KDD 2026 Workshop

> Half-day workshop at ACM SIGKDD 2026 on Agentic Software Engineering (SE 3.0): The Rise of AI Teammates. August 9, 2026 (morning), Room Samda B, Jeju International Convention Center, Jeju, Korea. Co-located with ACM SIGKDD 2026 (https://kdd2026.kdd.org/).

The workshop is anchored by the AIDev dataset — over one million agentic pull requests authored by AI coding agents on GitHub (https://huggingface.co/datasets/hao-li/AIDev).

## Topics

- Mining agent-generated artifacts: analyzing code, PRs, and commits produced by AI teammates at scale
- Human-agent collaboration and alignment
- Trustworthiness and reliability of agent outputs
- Multi-agent coordination and orchestration
- Agent tool use and environments (IDEs, CI/CD, development tools)
- Failure modes and root causes of AI agent errors
- Safety, ethics, and compliance of AI teammates
- Adoption and productivity impact of AI agents on developer workflows
- Economic cost and impact of agentic software development
- AgentOps and release engineering

## Key dates

- Paper submission: closed (June 1, 2026)
- Notification: June 10, 2026
- Workshop: August 9, 2026, at KDD 2026, Jeju, Korea

## Program

Half-day (morning) program with a keynote, oral presentations of accepted papers, and discussion. Accepted papers are listed with OpenReview links on the workshop website.
